input: Find small art studios, dance studios, music teachers and gyms that run a few weeks of summer camp for kids and teens in Asheville and Buncombe County, NC. Look past the big, well-known camps: search with varied wording and town names and list every organization you find.
searches: Asheville art studio summer camps 2026 kids

candidates.name: Jan's Art Academy
candidates.note: Small-group summer art camps with painting, drawing and mixed-media projects; 2026 camps listed.

candidates.name: Firefly Valley Design
candidates.note: Youth pottery camps; ran summer 2026 and announced summer 2027 registration.

candidates.name: Fired Up! Creative Lounge
candidates.note: Weeklong 2026 morning camps for ages 6–12 covering pottery, glass fusing and painting.

candidates.name: Local Cloth
candidates.note: 2026 teen sewing camps for ages 13–18, including beginner and project-focused sessions.

candidates.name: Asheville Conservatory of the Arts
candidates.note: 2026 camps include combined piano-and-art programming and ensemble music camps.

candidates.name: Music Academy Asheville & Rock Academy
candidates.note: Weeklong music camps with band practice and Friday performances at the Patton Avenue rehearsal space.

candidates.name: Asheville Music School
candidates.note: 2026 camps for ages 4–18 include rock, strings, ukulele, jazz, voice and audio production.

candidates.name: We Rock Asheville
candidates.note: 2026 weeklong band and songwriting camp at ArtSpace Charter School, followed by a showcase.

candidates.name: Center Stage Dance Studio
candidates.note: Themed children's camps and dance-training camps, including ballet groups for ages 6–14.

candidates.name: Asheville Contemporary Dance Theatre / New Studio of Dance
candidates.note: Summer 2026 dance camps and intensives at the Commerce Street studio.

candidates.name: Asheville Dance Theater
candidates.note: Themed summer camps combine dance, crafts and musical-theater activities.

candidates.name: Celia's Dance Academy
candidates.note: Summer dance camps advertised in June 2026; detailed camp hours and age groups were not published.

candidates.name: Ballet Conservatory of Asheville
candidates.note: 2026 children's workshops for ages 5–11 and a four-week pre-professional summer intensive.

candidates.name: The Asheville Ballet / Asheville Academy of Ballet and Contemporary Dance
candidates.note: Blue Ridge Dance Camp intensive for serious dancers ages 11–18; 2027 camp announced.

candidates.name: The Performing Arts Company of Asheville
candidates.note: Weeklong August 2026 summer dance intensive for ages 8–18.

candidates.name: Asheville Performing Arts Academy
candidates.note: Nine weeklong 2026 musical-theater camps divided into grades 1–3 and 4–9.

candidates.name: Black Mountain Center for the Arts
candidates.note: 2025–2026 performance-arts camps with music, dance, crafts and end-of-week showcases.

candidates.name: Asheville Community Movement
candidates.note: 2026 Movers and Shakers camps combine gymnastics, active play, crafts and weekly themes.

candidates.name: Hahn's Gymnastics
candidates.note: Summer camps for ages 3–12 with gym activities, crafts, games and full-day field trips.

candidates.name: Elevate Gymnastics & Cheer
candidates.note: Summer Wonders day camps for ages 3–12 with age-grouped activities and extended care.

candidates.name: Cultivate Climbing
candidates.note: Weeklong indoor climbing camps with coached climbing, games, creative activities and outings.

candidates.name: Asheville Community Yoga
candidates.note: 2026 children's yoga camp with movement, art, gardening and nature activities.

candidates.name: Asheville Sun Soo Martial Arts
candidates.note: 2026 summer camps for grades K–5 combine martial arts, themed activities and outdoor adventures.
